spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of dry, sandy ground with sparse tufts of grass against a plain off-white background. Its overall form is that of a large, heavy-bodied land tortoise: a high-domed shell forming the trunk, a thick scaly neck and tortoise-like head at the anterior, four stout columnar limbs supporting the body, and a short pointed tail at the posterior. The lateral and ventral portions of the shell are exposed and show hard scutes with brown, tan and pale yellow radiating patterns and slightly flared, serrated margins. The entire dorsal surface of the carapace is completely obscured by a voluminous, dense, matted mass of curly, shaggy brown wool that overhangs the shell edges and hangs down over the sides, contrasting sharply in texture with the hard, scaly skin and shell below.

attached_objects: No separate manufactured object or whole small animal is sitting on the body. Otherwise, attached_objects is empty.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged tortoise-like reptile shown in side view facing right, standing on sparse dry ground. It has a high domed hard shell with brown and tan scutes, a thick scaly reptilian head on an extended neck, four stout columnar scaly legs ending in clawed feet, and a short pointed scaly tail at the rear. The top and sides of the shell are covered by a voluminous mass of dense shaggy curly brown wool-like fur that drapes over the rim of the shell.

spark_open.description: The creature is a large tortoise-like reptile shown in right lateral profile standing on a small patch of dry, sparsely grassed ground. It has a high-domed shell whose lower sides and flared margins are visible as tan and dark brown scutes, four thick columnar legs heavily armored with scales ending in clawed feet, a short pointed scaly tail at the rear, and a reptilian head with a beaked mouth, dark eye, and scaly neck extended forward to the right. The entire dorsal surface of the shell is completely obscured by a dense, thick, matted mass of curly shaggy brown wool resembling a sheep's fleece that hangs down over the edges of the shell.
